chapter: Bird, Ben Webster and the 1950s decline
title: Ben Webster says both he and Bird studied with Lester Young's father
summary: Webster tells Freeman, with a caveat, about his link to Pres and Bird through Lester's father.

story.theme_name: Lester Young: the man, the sound, the Basie years
story.community_name: Remembering Lester Young: Prez the man and his sound

blocks.x: Yeah, he called me Kid. He says, “But don’t you play tenor? They told me you was a tenor player.” But I was in Calumet City at the time, playing alto, taking a cat’s place. This cat had a beautiful Selmer. I loved it. So I’d always go play alto at the session. That’s where I first got to really know him. This is when he laid something on me. He says – I say, “Mr. Ben, I hear something between you and Bird.” He said, “There’s a reason for that.” I said, “What?” He said, “Lester Young’s father taught instruments.” He said, “Both of us studied with Lester Young’s father.”
What do you mean, taught instruments? You mean he gave lessons?
Yeah, he was a music teacher. I didn’t know this.

He said, “Have you ever noticed, I’ve got a lot of Pres in me?” I said no. He said yeah. He said, “You ever noticed Bird got a lot of Pres in him?” I said, “Yeah. I noticed.” I said, “But I thought you was a Hawk man.” He said, “Oh, I admire Coleman Hawkins.” He said, “But I was taught by Pres’s” – he whispered, “I was taught by Pres’s
father, and so was Bird.” I said, “You’re kidding.” He said yeah. So see – he said, “I’ll tell you some more. We better go around the corner.”

I ended up buying at least three half pints. [?] It was costing $1.30 a bottle. Oh man, it’s funny. But that’s what he told me. I said wow. He said, “I’ll tell you the truth.” He said, “I used to play just like Pres.” He said, “So did Bird.” I said, “I kind of heard it a little bit in Bird.” He said yeah. He said, “Bird was just a little kid, 7, 8 years old,” or something like that. Take it for what it’s worth, because he could have been just putting me on. I don’t know.
But there is something similar about the embouchures.
